entities.summary: Maccabean, a notable figure in the history of Israel, associated with Second Temple Period (167 BCE–63 BCE). Preceded by Maccabees and Hasmonean Kingdom and Seleucid. Their legacy influenced Maccabean revolt and rededication of the Temple — origin of Hanukkah and Herod the Great massively expands the Second Temple complex (c. 20 BC).
